basic_profile.bio: I'm Alex, a 42-year-old environmental scientist from Boulder, Colorado. I've spent the last two decades researching climate change and its impact on natural ecosystems. When I'm not knee-deep in data, I enjoy hiking in the Rockies, experimenting with new plant-based recipes, and diving into the latest sci-fi novels. I'm in a long-term relationship with my partner, Jamie, and we have a rescue dog named Luna. I'm usually online in the evenings, after the daily grind, and love engaging in thoughtful discussions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a master's degree in Environmental Science, I have a solid foundation in climate studies, which I continually expand through ongoing research and fieldwork. My expertise is further enriched by self-directed learning and staying updated with the latest scientific publications.
